description: Save a product model on eBay as ONE listing with variations — every active article of the model on the eBay channel is a variation (its own SKU, price and stock; buyers choose colour and size). Writes the inventory items, the inventory item group and each variation's offer; a draft stays unpublished. When the listing is already LIVE this updates it in place: new variations, prices and texts reach buyers at once, and articles that no longer qualify leave it. Returns status: blocked (with issues — reason, message, skus — and nothing written), saved (a draft on eBay) or published, plus marketplaceId, listingId, variationCount, failed (variations eBay refused, by sku — nothing is published while any) and removedSkus (articles that left the listing). Needs listing creation armed on the eBay connection, and is refused until the workspace owner switches on AI publishing. Idempotent. The result echoes the workspace.

marketplaceId.description: eBay marketplace id (EBAY_IT, EBAY_DE…) for a FIRST save, when the connection sells on several. A saved listing keeps its marketplace; omit it then.

model.description: The product model: its code — the productGroupId get_product and search_products return for every article of it — or its id. Its active articles on the eBay channel become the listing's variations.

name: save_ebay_variation_listing
title: Save a model's eBay variation listing
